SESSION LOG — CI incident arc (epic 78f2 orchestration paused on hard-lock).

1. Applied pre-approved one-liner (Makefile pipefail fix, Gerrit 2612) — LANDED but
   INSUFFICIENT: it let the scanner-integration recipe run, exposing a latent contract
   failure at the pytest step.
2. Executed pre-approved revert (Gerrit 2616) — BLOCKED by review-bot LLM-Review -1
   (reintroduces unpinned gitleaks/semgrep, drops WS5 secret-detection contracts).
3. DEFINITIVE RCA: gerrit-verify.yaml `vote` aggregate requires
   scanner-integration.result=='success' on every full-route change. Scanner contract
   fails → Verified -1 on ALL full-route changes. The fix itself is full-route → same
   self-validation lock. Breaking it requires ONE human force-submit (agents must not
   force). 2600/2612 only landed via prior force-submits.
4. Prepared de-gate (Gerrit 2617, WIP) — RECOMMENDED fix: scanner job stays advisory
   (runs, doesn't gate). Preserves aa9e hardening/tests; clears bot objections; fixes the
   lock for all future changes. YAML+actionlint pass.

STATUS: ESCALATED to operator for force-submit decision (2617 recommended vs 2616).
Nothing lands autonomously. Agents: 3 leaves running (828b, c195, aa9e), rest idle/parked;
all ultimately gated on this lock. Full detail on incident ticket 90c7.
